title: NotificationEventWriteRequest
description: Secret-free administrative notification event. metadata and all other unknown properties are rejected. Raw tokens, credentials, webhook URLs, passwords, authorization values, and other secrets must never be supplied in any field.

action.description: Required stable dotted ASCII identifier; raw values are prohibited.

resource_id.description: Non-secret opaque resource identifier. URLs, credentials, tokens, and control characters are prohibited.

actor_username.description: Display-safe non-secret actor name; control characters are prohibited.

summary.description: Short display-safe summary. Raw secrets, URLs carrying credentials, and control characters are prohibited.

timestamp.description: Optional source event time. It is context only and not an outbox or idempotency identifier.
